cbp_2023.label: CBP 2023 employer establishments (Bibb County)
cbp_2023.source: U.S. Census Bureau, County Business Patterns, 2023, Bibb County, GA
cbp_2023.note: Most methodologically transparent employer-establishment count; corroborated by JobsEQ/QCEW (~4,300).

esri_data_axle_2026.label: Esri/Data Axle ‘2026 Total Businesses (NAICS)’ (MBCIA Local Data page)
esri_data_axle_2026.source: MBCIA Local Data page, embedded Esri Workforce Overview dashboard (business-listing file, April 2026 vintage)
esri_data_axle_2026.note: Broader universe than CBP — Data Axle's own methodology says it includes freelancers, contractors, home-based businesses, and coworking spaces. Not a clean employer-establishment count. Geographic scope (Bibb County vs. broader labor market area) is ASSUMED, not confirmed — verify against MBCIA site before publishing externally.
